bead.title: tests: make default routing and service gates hermetic and fail-fast
bead.description:
PROBLEM
A routine push from /home/erik/Projects/fizeau was blocked by the pre-push hook because the full test gate entered slow/hanging live-provider paths. The hook reached `go test -count=1 ./...` and timed out after 10m in tests including `TestRouter_AllProvidersDead_FailsFast` and `TestCLI_ExecuteUsesServiceContract`. Related tests such as `TestResolveRoute_UnknownLocalHealthDoesNotBlockSubscriptionFallback` and `TestExecute_RouteResolutionUsesCallerContextAndNonblockingLocalHealth` consumed roughly 85s each before the timeout. This makes normal worker audit pushes unreliable and prevents autonomous queue burn-down.

ROOT CAUSE
The failing path appears to exercise live PTY/provider/aliveness behavior during the default `go test ./...` / pre-push gate instead of using hermetic stubs with bounded contexts. Evidence from the 2026-05-21 pre-push run: timeout in routing/service tests involving all-providers-dead, service contract execution, and nonblocking local health checks.

PROPOSED FIX
Make the default test and pre-push path hermetic and bounded. Replace live provider/aliveness dependencies in these tests with in-process fakes or explicit short timeouts, and ensure the all-providers-dead case fails fast under `go test ./... -count=1` without depending on local daemon state.

NON-SCOPE
Do not weaken routing behavior or remove the behavioral assertions. Do not bypass pre-push. Do not move these tests into a manual-only suite unless an equivalent fast hermetic unit/integration check remains in the default gate.
bead.acceptance:
1. `go test ./... -count=1 -timeout=3m` completes without hanging on live provider or PTY availability.
2. `TestResolveRoute_UnknownLocalHealthDoesNotBlockSubscriptionFallback` and `TestExecute_RouteResolutionUsesCallerContextAndNonblockingLocalHealth` use bounded fake/local collaborators and complete quickly under the default gate.
3. `TestRouter_AllProvidersDead_FailsFast` proves the all-dead case returns an error without waiting on live daemon/provider probes.
4. `TestCLI_ExecuteUsesServiceContract` does not require a live external harness/provider in the default test suite.
5. `lefthook run pre-push origin https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau` reaches the normal git push path without a Go test timeout.
